title: The Pelican Nebula in Gas, Dust, and Stars
explanation:
# The Pelican Nebula Reborn

A cosmic masterpiece captured with 25 hours of telescope time reveals the Pelican Nebula in the throes of transformation—young, fiery stars are slowly heating the cold gas around them, creating a brilliant orange boundary that marks the advancing edge of this stellar metamorphosis. Over millions of years, this nebula will evolve so dramatically that its current bird-like shape will dissolve entirely, reshaping itself into something unrecognizable as the balance of stars and gas shifts and swirls through space.
